# Story Ask

A fantasy cartographer's apprentice novel. Alory Vane, journeyman surveyor of
the Guild, returns from a northern survey and discovers her measurements
contradict the Guild's official records by four degrees — and that her mentor
Master Therin died for the same discovery.

Chapter 1 turns the confrontation scene: Alory confronts Elara Venn, the
Surveyor who holds the truth, over the discrepancy and the price of it.

Style: restrained heroic fantasy — declarative cadence (~20w sentences),
sparing sensory density, externalized stakes. See prompts/writer/style-primer-salvatore.md
for the era voice reference (replace per-novel).
